title: Student Attendance REST API
description: Design and build a token-authenticated RESTful API that tracks college course sessions, student attendance, and generates summary attendance reports.
learning_outcomes: Relational table design and SQLite foreign keys
Unit testing API endpoints with pytest

milestones.title: Schema design and database initialization script
Implement CRUD endpoints for students and courses
Implement attendance recording with date filters
Add automated test suite covering all routes

title: Automated Web Scraper & Excel Report Pipeline
description: Scrapes public tech job listings, parses required keywords, and exports a formatted multi-sheet Excel spreadsheet with trend charts.
learning_outcomes: Data formatting and clean error handling

milestones.title: Fetch and parse HTML pages cleanly
Extract job title, salary range, and tech stack
Write processed records to Excel file
Document code in a GitHub repository README

title: Interactive Kanban Task Management Board
description: A responsive Trello-style board with drag-and-drop task movement, local storage state persistence, and tag filtering.
learning_outcomes: DOM event delegation and state sync

milestones.title: Semantic HTML layout with columns (To-Do, Doing, Done)
Card creation modal with title, tags, and date
Drag-and-drop event handlers and reordering
Save board state to browser localStorage

title: Equity Research Model of Tech Sector
description: Develop a comprehensive 3-statement financial model linking Balance Sheet, P&L, and Cash Flow with Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) valuation.
learning_outcomes: WACC (Weighted Average Cost of Capital) estimation
Sensitivity analysis with Excel Data Tables

milestones.title: Historical financial data input from annual reports
Forecast revenue growth, margins, and capex assumptions
Build dynamic DCF model and terminal value calculation
Draft 3-page investment thesis executive summary

title: Campus Food Delivery App UX Case Study
description: End-to-end design case study addressing long canteen queues: user interviews, personas, journey maps, wireframes, and interactive Figma prototype.
learning_outcomes: User research synthesis and problem definition
Low to high-fidelity wireframing in Figma

milestones.title: User research interviews with 5 students and 2 vendors
Information architecture and low-fidelity paper wireframes
Design system setup: typography, colors, component library
Clickable high-fidelity Figma prototype and testing

title: Library Management Business Requirement Document (BRD)
description: Complete formal Business Requirements Document with BPMN process maps for digital student book reservation and fine tracking.
learning_outcomes: User stories with clear acceptance criteria

milestones.title: Stakeholder identification and scope definition
As-Is vs To-Be process workflow mapping
Draft 10 functional requirements and 5 non-functional requirements
Final BRD review and sign-off presentation deck
